scope: first complete semantic pass, canonical ordinals 9353-9428

findings.source: Fugitive: Говорю же, пуля насквозь прошла.
findings.currentTarget: Fugitive: Îți spun, glonțul m-a străpuns.
findings.reason: Russian «пуля насквозь прошла» states that the bullet passed all the way through. Romanian «m-a străpuns» establishes penetration but does not explicitly preserve the exit/through-and-through detail of the wound.
findings.proposedTarget: Fugitive: Îți spun, glonțul m-a străpuns dintr-o parte în alta.
